This document provides detailed guidance on achieving consistent watercolour style for goal images.

## Style Characteristics

### Colour & Light

#### Bright/Hopeful Scenes
- Warm golden yellows and oranges
- Soft greens and blues
- Strong directional light sources
- Atmospheric glow and lens flare effects
- Saturated highlights, desaturated shadows

#### Dark/Foreboding Scenes
- Cool blue-greys dominate
- Deep shadows with subtle warm accents
- Ambient light rather than strong sources
- Muted, almost monochromatic palette
- Silhouettes and lost edges

#### Neutral/Journey Scenes
- Earth tones: browns, greens, muted blues
- Overcast or diffused lighting
- Mid-range values
- Balanced warm/cool temperature

### Technique

#### Wet-on-Wet Effects
- Soft colour bleeding at edges
- Diffused transitions between forms
- Unpredictable organic shapes in backgrounds
- "Happy accidents" look in colour mixing

#### Atmospheric Perspective
- Sharp detail in foreground
- Progressively softer/lighter background
- Blue-grey tinting on distant elements
- Misty/hazy middle distance

#### Brushwork
- Visible brush strokes add texture
- Loose, confident marks
- Varied brush sizes for interest
- Some areas left deliberately unfinished

### Composition

#### Figures in Landscape
- Characters are small relative to environment
- Silhouettes or simple shapes, not portraits
- Placement emphasises journey/scale
- Often positioned on paths, bridges, or thresholds

#### Scale & Grandeur
- Emphasise the epic scale of Middle-earth
- Large skies, towering mountains, vast distances
- Use small figures to show immensity

---

## Mood-to-Style Mapping

| Narrative Mood | Colour Palette | Lighting | Edge Quality |
|----------------|---------------|----------|--------------|
| Hope/Peace | Warm golds, soft greens | Bright, diffused | Soft, flowing |
| Wonder/Awe | Cool blues, silvers, ethereal whites | Dramatic, otherworldly | Mixed sharp/soft |
| Dread/Fear | Dark blues, blacks, murky greens | Limited, ominous | Lost edges, shadows |
| Weariness | Muted earth tones, greys | Overcast, flat | Soft, tired |
| Urgency/Action | High contrast, warm accents | Dynamic, directional | Sharp, energetic |
| Sorrow/Loss | Blue-greys, muted purples | Dim, melancholic | Soft, bleeding |

---

## Location-Specific Guidelines

### The Shire (0-70 miles)
- Idyllic, pastoral quality
- Bright greens, warm sunlight
- Cozy hobbit architecture (round doors, gardens)
- Gentle rolling hills

### Old Forest & Barrow-downs (70-135 miles)
- Darker, more mysterious
- Deep greens, shadowy
- Twisted trees, fog
- Ancient, slightly menacing

### Bree to Rivendell (135-458 miles)
- Wild, untamed lands
- Weather-beaten, rugged
- Autumn colours on approach to Rivendell
- Weathertop: exposed, windy, dramatic

### Rivendell (458-466 miles)
- Elven ethereal quality
- Autumn golds and reds
- Graceful architecture
- Waterfalls and hidden valleys

### Misty Mountains & Moria (466-842 miles)
- Snow and rock
- Stark, harsh contrasts
- Underground: darkness with occasional light
- Claustrophobic vs. vast caverns

### Lothlórien (842-930 miles)
- Golden light filtering through trees
- Silver and gold colour palette
- Otherworldly, dreamlike quality
- Mallorn trees (silver bark, gold leaves)

### River Journey (930-1309 miles)
- Water reflections
- Grey, overcast skies often
- Emyn Muil: brown, barren, rocky
- Argonath: massive stone figures

### Mordor Approach (1309-1779 miles)
- Increasingly dark and bleak
- Dead Marshes: sickly greens, ghostly lights
- Mordor: ash, fire, darkness
- Mount Doom: volcanic reds and oranges

### Return Journey (1779+ miles)
- Gradually brightening
- Hope returning
- Mix of familiar and changed landscapes
- Shire return: bittersweet

## Prompt Keywords

### Style Base
```
watercolour, watercolor, painted, wet-on-wet, soft edges, brushwork, 
atmospheric, textured paper, traditional media, Alan Lee, John Howe
```

### Atmosphere
```
misty, ethereal, atmospheric, diffused light, moody, dramatic, 
ambient glow, soft focus, dreamlike, hazy
```

### Technique
```
loose brushstrokes, colour bleeding, wet wash, layered washes,
granulation, visible texture, organic edges, painterly
```

### Avoid
```
photorealistic, digital art, 3D render, sharp edges, oversaturated,
cartoon, anime, graphic novel, modern, text, watermark, border, frame
```
